SELECT count(*) AS record_count, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (inventory_records.document_type = %(document_type_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN abs(coalesce(inventory_records.total_count, %(coalesce_1)s::INTEGER)) ELSE coalesce(inventory_records.total_count, %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) END), %(coalesce_3)s::INTEGER) AS total_count, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (inventory_records.document_type = %(document_type_2)s::VARCHAR) THEN abs(coalesce(inventory_records.amount, %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER)) ELSE coalesce(inventory_records.amount, %(coalesce_5)s::INTEGER) END), %(coalesce_6)s::INTEGER) AS amount 
FROM inventory_records 
WHERE inventory_records.deleted_at IS NULL AND (inventory_records.document_type IS NULL OR inventory_records.document_type != %(document_type_3)s::VARCHAR) AND (coalesce(inventory_records.supplier IN (SELECT general_customer_shops.shop_name 
FROM general_customer_shops 
WHERE general_customer_shops.shop_name ILIKE %(shop_name_1)s::VARCHAR UNION ALL SELECT general_customer_units.unit_name 
FROM general_customer_units JOIN general_customer_shops ON general_customer_units.shop_id = general_customer_shops.id 
WHERE general_customer_shops.shop_name ILIKE %(shop_name_2)s::VARCHAR), %(coalesce_7)s) OR inventory_records.document_type IS NOT NULL AND inventory_records.document_type IN (%(document_type_4_1)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_4_2)s::VARCHAR) AND replace(coalesce(inventory_records.supplier, %(coalesce_8)s::VARCHAR), %(replace_1)s::VARCHAR, %(replace_2)s::VARCHAR) LIKE %(replace_3)s::VARCHAR OR (EXISTS (SELECT inventory_details.id 
FROM inventory_details 
WHERE inventory_details.document_id = inventory_records.id)) AND (inventory_records.document_type IN (%(document_type_5_1)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_5_2)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_5_3)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_5_4)s::VARCHAR) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT inventory_details.id 
FROM inventory_details 
WHERE inventory_details.document_id = inventory_records.id AND (inventory_details.amount IS NULL OR inventory_details.amount = %(amount_1)s::INTEGER))) OR (inventory_records.document_type IS NULL OR (inventory_records.document_type NOT IN (%(document_type_6_1)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_6_2)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_6_3)s::VARCHAR, %(document_type_6_4)s::VARCHAR))) AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT inventory_details.id 
FROM inventory_details 
WHERE inventory_details.document_id = inventory_records.id AND (inventory_details.unit_price IS NULL OR inventory_details.unit_price = %(unit_price_1)s::INTEGER)))))
